# Xanmere Cloud

Xanmere Cloud specializes in satellite imagery analytics tailored for the insurance sector, focusing on roof condition scoring, flood extent visualization, and catastrophe response enhancement. Their flagship product, FloodScope, delivers near real-time mapping of flood extents, enabling disaster management agencies to accelerate and optimize emergency response and resource allocation.

Currently deployed in seven countries across Southeast Asia and Central America, FloodScope processes over 200,000 square kilometers of flood-affected regions each month. This extensive coverage helps clients anticipate damage patterns and prioritize critical interventions. Xanmere Cloud’s customer base includes national disaster management agencies and regional insurers seeking to reduce claims processing time and improve risk assessment accuracy.

Founded in 2020, Xanmere Cloud has completed a $7.5 million Series A funding round led by the Nimbrel Venture Fund. The company employs 28 people, including a core team of geospatial data scientists, software engineers, and catastrophe risk analysts. CEO Amira DeLuca leads product innovation with CTO Rajiv Banerjee overseeing technology development.

Competitors in this niche include TerraLens Analytics and HydroVision Systems, both offering flood mapping solutions but lacking Xanmere Cloud’s near real-time processing speed. Key risks involve satellite data latency, regulatory restrictions on data sharing, and dependence on cloud infrastructure stability. Ongoing investments focus on expanding geographic coverage and strengthening data integration capabilities.
